seed_memories.content:
Supplier Rowan service reference. This manually curated contract must remain unchanged.
Inspection: photograph the crate condition before unpacking and retain the receiving signature.
Receiving: match each serial number to the dispatch note before accepting the equipment.
Installation: keep the mounting area level and record the initial gauge calibration certificate.
Electrical checks: use the rated supply shown on the equipment label and record the connection inspection.
Routine service: log lubrication, seal inspection, and calibration findings in the maintenance register.
Repair requests: include the serial number, fault description, observation date, and safe shutdown status.
Replacement parts: record the original part number and keep the removed part for supplier review.
Returns: obtain a return reference before shipment and include the service record with the equipment.
Packaging: use fitted protective supports and keep loose accessories in an identified separate package.
Transport: retain shipment tracking and the signed receiving record for any return movement.
Downtime records: distinguish planned inspection from failure-related stoppages in the maintenance log.
Handover: provide the operator with the inspection record, service instructions, and contact route.
Document control: preserve this signed reference and record any future supplier amendment separately.
Coverage tail: the supplier Rowan warranty duration is 73 months.
